FAQ — AqiNode FAQ Frequently Asked Questions Everything you need to know about AqiNode — who we are, what we're building, and where we're going. Still curious? Talk to us directly. All Company Products Vision Technical Collaborate Company What is AqiNode? AqiNode is a multi-product technology company building an ecosystem of intelligent software systems. We design and ship products that sit at the intersection of AI, automation, and modern infrastructure — built to scale, built to last. Is AqiNode a startup, agency, or something else? AqiNode is a product-first startup company — not a freelance operation, not a traditional agency. We build and own our products long-term. Every system we create is part of a broader ecosystem we're developing with the same ambition that drives companies like Google or Meta. We're early — but we're building with that scale in mind from day one. Where is AqiNode based? We're remote-native and distributed across time zones. Our products are built for a global audience and our team operates without borders. We communicate through email, WhatsApp, and X. How long has AqiNode been around? AqiNode is an early-stage company. We're in active build mode — shipping products, iterating fast, and laying the infrastructure for what we're becoming. Early doesn't mean small. It means the best time to pay attention is now. Products What products is AqiNode building? Feel free to have a look at our products page. Are your products free to use? Pricing varies by product. We'll always offer accessible entry points — we believe in building products people can actually use. How do I get early access to your products? Join the waitlist on the relevant product page. Early access users get first access, influence over features, and often locked-in pricing. You can also follow us on X at @aqinode_hq for launch announcements. What problem does AqiNode's ecosystem solve? The digital world is full of disconnected tools, workflows, and systems. AqiNode builds products that are intelligent by default — systems that adapt, automate, and scale. We're removing friction from how people build, learn, and work online. Vision What is AqiNode's long-term vision? We're building toward a future where AqiNode is a globally recognized technology ecosystem — a company that owns and operates multiple high-impact products used by millions. The same way Google started with search and expanded into every layer of digital life, we're starting with focused AI products and expanding systematically. The goal is scale, reach, and lasting relevance. Why does AqiNode focus on AI? AI isn't a trend for us — it's the foundation. Every product we build is designed to be intelligent from the ground up. We believe the next generation of software won't just respond to users — it'll anticipate them, learn from them, and work for them autonomously. That's the layer we're building on. How does AqiNode plan to compete with large tech companies? Speed, focus, and originality. We ship fast, stay close to real user needs, and build products that solve problems the giants have overlooked or overcomplicated. We're not trying to copy what already exists, we're building what comes next. Every major tech company started as a small team with a big idea. We're that team. Technical Are your products open source? Our core products are proprietary. We may open-source certain utilities or components in the future, but the primary product ecosystem is closed-source to protect the integrity and competitive advantage of what we're building. How do you handle data and privacy? Privacy is a design principle, not a checkbox. We collect only what's necessary, never sell user data, and implement appropriate security measures across all our products. Read our full Privacy Policy for details. Collaborate Can I partner with AqiNode? Yes. We're open to partnerships that align with our mission — integrations, co-building, distribution partnerships, or strategic alliances. If you're building something that complements what we're doing, let's talk. Reach out via our contact page. Do you take on client projects? Selectively. We're primarily a product company, but we occasionally collaborate on external builds that are technically interesting or strategically aligned with our ecosystem. If you have something ambitious in mind, tell us about it — we'll be honest about whether it's a fit. How can I join the AqiNode team? We're always interested in people who build things, think big, and move fast. Check our Careers page for open roles. If nothing is listed but you believe you'd add real value, send a speculative application to aqinodelabs@gmail.com — we read everything. Can I invest in AqiNode? AqiNode is currently focused on building and expanding its ecosystem, and we're not actively fundraising at this stage. However, we’re open to connecting with investors and strategic partners who believe in long-term technology infrastructure, AI, and scalable digital products. If you're interested in being part of AqiNode early, reach out at aqinodelabs@gmail.com with the subject line "Investment Inquiry". Still curious? Didn't find what you were looking for? We're a real team and we respond. Send us a message and we'll get back to you directly. Talk to Us aqinodelabs@gmail.com

AqiNode – Privacy Policy Legal · Privacy Privacy Policy At AqiNode, your privacy isn't an afterthought — it's a design principle. This policy explains what we collect, why we collect it, and how we protect it. Last updated: April 2026 v1.0 Quick summary: We collect only what we need, we don't sell your data, and we treat every user with respect. Read the full policy below or contact us with any questions. 01 Information We Collect + We collect information you voluntarily provide when you interact with us. This may include: Contact details — your name and email address when you submit our contact form or reach out directly. Communication content — messages, inquiries, or project briefs you send to us. Technical data — browser type, IP address, and pages visited, collected automatically through standard web analytics. Employment information — CVs or application details if you apply for a position via our Careers page. We do not collect sensitive personal data such as payment information, government IDs, or biometric data. 02 How We Use Your Information + We use the information we collect solely to operate and improve our services. Specifically: To respond to inquiries — when you contact us, we use your details to reply and follow up. To process applications — if you apply for a role, your information is used to evaluate your candidacy. To improve our website — anonymised analytics help us understand how visitors use the site so we can make it better. To comply with legal obligations — where required by law, we may process or retain certain data. We do not use your data for advertising, profiling, or any automated decision-making. 03 Sharing Your Information + We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to any third party. We may share data only in these limited circumstances: Service providers — trusted tools we use to run our operations (e.g. email delivery, analytics), who are contractually bound to protect your data. Legal requirements — if required by law, court order, or government authority. Business transfers — in the unlikely event of a merger or acquisition, your data may be transferred as part of that process, with appropriate notice provided. 04 Cookies & Tracking + Our website may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience. These include: Essential cookies — necessary for the website to function correctly (e.g. theme preference). Analytics cookies — help us understand traffic patterns and improve the site. These are anonymised. You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect site functionality such as theme persistence. 05 Data Security + We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure. While we strive to protect your data using industry-standard practices, we cannot guarantee absolute security. We encourage users to exercise care when sharing personal information online. 06 Data Retention + We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purpose it was collected for, or as required by applicable law. Contact form submissions are typically retained for up to 12 months. Job applications are held for the duration of the recruitment process and deleted thereafter unless you give consent for us to retain them longer. You may request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us at aqinodelabs@gmail.com. 07 Your Rights + You have the right to: Access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you. Correction — request that we correct any inaccurate or incomplete information. Deletion — ask us to delete your personal data where there is no legitimate reason for us to continue processing it. Restriction — ask us to limit how we process your data in certain circumstances. Portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format where applicable. Objection — object to certain types of processing, including direct marketing. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at aqinodelabs@gmail.com. 08 Changes to This Policy + We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time as our services evolve or legal requirements change. When we do, we'll revise the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. We encourage you to review this page periodically. Continued use of our website after changes are posted constitutes your acknowledgement of the updated policy. Have questions about your privacy? We're happy to clarify anything in this policy or address any concerns you may have. Get In Touch
